description: Requires a WarStrikes API key with the Events layer. Events: one occurrence linked to all the reports that describe it, with precision, entities, sectors and impacts. Same filters as GET /api/v1/events.

asset_type.description: port, oil_terminal, airport, power_station, chokepoint, canal; comma-separated.

cursor.description: next_cursor from a previous page; send it alone to get the next page.

domain.description: e.g. conflict, maritime, energy, infrastructure, comma-separated.

sector.description: e.g. shipping, oil_gas, energy, insurance, comma-separated.

since.description: Start of the window, ISO 8601 UTC (default: 7 days ago).

until.description: End of the window, ISO 8601 UTC (default: now).

name: search_events
title: Search Events (API key)
